camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise GrantUserPermission --region cn-hangzhou --PermTypes QUERY --ExpireDate '2021-12-12_00:00:00' --UserId 510000 --DsType DATABASE
description_en: Grants permissions on an instance, a database, or a table to a user
description_zh: 授予用户实例、库、表权限
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise grant-user-permission --user-id 510000 --ds-type DATABASE --perm-types QUERY --expire-date 2021-12-12_00:00:00 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantUserPermission

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html operation to query the ID of the user.

The user ID is different from the ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html获取该参数的值。
用户ID不是用户的阿里云Uid
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The permissions on a specific type of object that you want to grant to the user. Valid values:

INSTANCE: permissions on instances
DATABASE: permissions on physical databases
LOGIC_DATABASE: permissions on logical databases
TABLE: permissions on physical tables
LOGIC_TABLE: permissions on logical tables
parameters.help_zh:
权限类型，取值：
INSTANCE: 实例权限
DATABASE： 物理库权限
LOGIC_DATABASE：逻辑库权限
TABLE：物理表权限
LOGIC_TABLE：逻辑表权限
parameters.name: ds_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You must specify this parameter if you grant permissions on an instance to the user. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to query the ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，授权实例权限时需要指定。可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to query the ID of a physical database and the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html operation to query the ID of a logical database.

The value of the DatabaseId parameter is that of the DbId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html获取物理库ID的值，调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html获取逻辑库ID的值。
DatabaseId的值即为DbId的值
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. You must specify this parameter if you grant permissions on a database to the user. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is a physical database
parameters.help_zh:
是否是逻辑库，授权数据库权限时需要指定。取值：
true：逻辑库
false：物理库
parameters.name: logic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the table. You must specify this parameter if you grant permissions on a table to the user. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html operation to query the table ID
parameters.help_zh: 表ID，授权表权限时需要指定。可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the table. You must specify this parameter if you grant permissions on a table to the user
parameters.help_zh: 表名，授权表权限时需要指定
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en:
The permission type. Separate multiple permission types with commas (,). Valid values:

QUERY: the query permissions
EXPORT: the export permissions
CORRECT: the change permissions
LOGIN: the logon permissions
PERF: the query permissions on the performance details of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
权限类型，取值如下：
QUERY：查询
EXPORT：导出
CORRECT：变更
LOGIN：登录权限
PERF：实例性能查看权限
parameters.name: perm_types

parameters.help_en: The time when the permissions expire
parameters.name: expire_date

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
